anti-sycophancy.use_when: Use when ensuring AI responses avoid sycophantic agreement during meetings.

capture.use_when: Use when capturing ideas, brain dumps, or meeting notes during or immediately after meetings.

challenge.use_when: Use when performing pre-mortem risk analysis before committing resources in meetings.

executive-mentor.use_when: Use when preparing for or debriefing difficult executive or board meetings.

postmortem.use_when: Use when analyzing failures or issues after a launch or project milestone.

product-discovery.use_when: Use when validating product opportunities or planning discovery sprints during product meetings.

research-summarizer.use_when: Use when summarizing or comparing research papers or reports discussed in meetings.

roadmap-communicator.use_when: Use when preparing or presenting product roadmaps or release notes in meetings.

stress-test.use_when: Use when stress-testing business assumptions before major plans.
